deep.reconstruction:
CONTEXT. The sheet is the blank side of a draft legal reply. It answers 'Bemerkungen des Herrn Pastor Riemann vom 29 Mai 1857' and concerns compensation for 'Melioramente', i.e. improvements on church land. The top paragraph continues that draft (living improvements, valuation by 'Taxatoren'). The heading 'B. F...nde Melioramente' is part of the legal text, not mathematics. Riemann reused the paper for genus-3 (plane quartic) theta computations. These belong to the same circle as his posthumous 'Zur Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen fuer den Fall p=3' (Werke 1876, ed. Weber) and as Weber's 1876 book.

1. NORMAL FORM OF THE QUARTIC. Let x, y, eta, xi, zeta be linear forms and t = -x-y-eta-xi-zeta. The curve is written
 sqrt(x y) + sqrt(eta xi) + sqrt(zeta t) = 0.
Rationalising gives f := 2 sqrt(x y eta xi) = zeta t - x y - eta xi (written '2 sqrt(xy eta xi) = f'). So the quartic is (zeta t - xy - eta xi)^2 = 4 x y eta xi. On this curve the six forms x, y, eta, xi, zeta, t are bitangents.

2. THE OTHER TWO PAIRINGS. The product xy*eta*xi can also be split as (x eta)(y xi) or (x xi)(y eta). Riemann computes the following (verification mine):
 (zeta+y+eta)(zeta+x+xi) - x eta - y xi = zeta(zeta+x+y+eta+xi) + xy + eta xi = -zeta t + xy + eta xi = -f.
 (zeta+x+eta)(zeta+y+xi) - x xi - y eta = -f, by the same computation.
Hence the same curve is also
 sqrt(x eta) + sqrt(y xi) + sqrt((zeta+y+eta)(zeta+x+xi)) = 0,
 sqrt(x xi) + sqrt(y eta) + sqrt((zeta+x+eta)(zeta+y+xi)) = 0.
This exhibits four further bitangents. The page lines 'x eta + y xi = (zeta+y+eta)(zeta+x+xi)' and 'x xi + y eta - (zeta+x+eta)(zeta+y+xi)' are these identities with f suppressed. The left column of square-root sums lists further 3-term representations, e.g. sqrt(x(zeta+y+eta)) + sqrt(eta(zeta+x+xi)).

3. NUMBERING AND LINEAR RELATIONS. The ten bitangents are numbered
 1 = x, 2 = y, 3 = eta, 4 = xi, 5 = zeta, 6 = t,
 7 = zeta+y+eta, 8 = zeta+x+xi, 9 = zeta+x+eta, X(=10) = zeta+y+xi.
The lines '5+2+3 = (6+1+4)' etc. define 7 = 5+2+3 = -(6+1+4), 8 = 5+1+4 = -(6+2+3), X = 5+2+4 = -(6+1+3), 9 = 5+1+3 = -(6+2+4). The minus signs are implicit; 'x+y+eta+xi+zeta+t = 0' is mine.
Riemann then lists the relations 7+8+6-5 = 0, X+9+6-5 = 0, 7+8-X-9 = 0, 3-7-4+X = 0 and 2-7-1+9 = 0. All are correct identities.
The pairings 12|34|56, 13|24|78 and 14|23|9X are the three representations of step 2.

4. CHARACTERISTICS. Each bitangent root gets a 2x3 binary characteristic:
 sqrt x = [111;111], sqrt y = [100;100], sqrt eta = [010;010], two letters = [001;001] and [100;111], sqrt t = [111;100],
 sqrt(zeta+y+eta) = [010;111], sqrt(zeta+x+xi) = [111;010], and the last two forms = [001;111], [111;001].
All ten are odd characteristics (g.h = 1 mod 2).
The Steiner-complex condition for sqrt(ab)+sqrt(cd)+sqrt(ef) = 0 is that the three pair-sums agree mod 2. It checks out if xi = [001;001] and zeta = [100;111]:
 x+y = eta+xi = zeta+t = [011;011];
 x+eta = y+xi = 7+8 = [101;101];
 x+xi = y+eta = 9+X = [110;110].
The left-column pair sqrt(x(zeta+y+eta)) + sqrt(eta(zeta+x+xi)) also checks: both pair-sums are [101;000].
The '1 2 / -13 -24 -78 / -14 -23 -9X' table records the pairings with sign choices.

5. DEGENERATION ON A BITANGENT. On zeta = 0 the curve reduces to xy = eta xi with a double root (zeta touches). The small blocks 'Sigma(eta) + [111;111] = [000;010]' and 'Sigma(eta) + [100;100] = [010;010]' appear to add the characteristic of a sum of integrals. My tentative reading is that this locates the contact divisor of eta relative to the characteristics of x and y; I am not certain of it. The quotient characteristics sqrt(xi/x) = ..., sqrt(zeta/x) = ... are likewise not securely readable.

6. THETA QUOTIENTS. The central formula is
 sqrt(x x1 / (y y1)) = A * theta(u - u1 + [111;111]) / theta(u - u1 + [100;100]) * e^(linear),
where u, u1 are Abel images of two points and the half-periods are the characteristics of x and y. In modern terms: theta[e](u(p)-u(q)) = E(p,q) h_e(p) h_e(q) with h_e^2 = omega_e, the bitangent differential. So the quotient of two odd theta functions is the square root of a cross-ratio of bitangent forms. This is correct.
A three-point generalisation is attempted with 3x3 determinants:
 sqrt(x2 x3 x4 x5) * Sigma ± (f/x) x1 y2 eta3 / [sqrt(y2 y3 y4 y5) * Sigma ± (f/y) ...] = A theta(...+[111;111]) / theta(...+[100;100]) e.
The special points are chosen as contact points: x2 = 0, x3 = 0, f2 = f3 = 0, xi4 = xi5 = 0. A side calculation 'sqrt(x2 x3 x4 x5 / (y2 y3 y4 y5)) = A^2' is crossed out.

7. EVALUATING THETA CONSTANTS. With both points on zeta = 0 (zeta = 0, zeta1 = 0), the relation sqrt(xy) = -sqrt(eta xi) gives sign rules such as sqrt(x/eta) = -sqrt(xi/y). A ratio of differences of square roots is rewritten as (eta/y - eta1/y1)/(xi/x - xi1/x1). The final line is
 (theta[001;010] / theta[010;001])^2 = sqrt(x2 x3 y4 y5 / (y2 y3 x4 x5)) * ((y eta1 - eta y1)/(x xi1 - xi x1))^2 * x x1 / (y y1),
under x2 = 0, eta3 = 0, xi4 = xi5 = 0, zeta = zeta1 = 0. Both characteristics are even. This expresses a ratio of two even theta constants (squared) through bitangent values at contact points. It is a Riemann/Weber-type expression of genus-3 theta-Nullwerte through the Aronhold/Steiner bitangent configuration.
errors: The letter assignment in the characteristic list is inconsistent with the formulas as transcribed. With 'sqrt zeta = [001;001], sqrt xi = [100;111]' the first representation fails the Steiner condition (x+y = [011;011] but eta+xi = [110;101]). Swapping the two letters makes all three representations consistent. This is most likely a transcription confusion of Riemann's zeta/xi (or Fraktur letters), possibly a slip in the manuscript itself.
The bitangent relations '5+2+3 = (6+1+4)' etc. omit the minus sign: correctly 5+2+3 = -(6+1+4), since the six forms sum to zero. The parentheses may encode this.
The transcribed line '+x eta + y xi(-x-y-eta-xi-zeta) + (y+zeta+eta)(xi+zeta+xi)' is garbled; the intended identity is (zeta+y+eta)(zeta+x+xi) - x eta - y xi = xy + eta xi - zeta t.

Some left-column square-root triples (e.g. sqrt(x zeta) - sqrt(eta t), sqrt(x t) - sqrt(zeta eta)) do not satisfy the Steiner pair-sum condition under either letter assignment. Either the transcription is wrong or these are trial lines.

The determinant formula and the final theta-constant formula carry an undetermined constant A and an exponential factor e. Their normalisation cannot be checked from the page alone; the final formula is plausible in form but unverified.

results.what: Representation of a plane quartic as sqrt(xy)+sqrt(eta xi)+sqrt(zeta t)=0 with x+y+eta+xi+zeta+t=0, and its two re-pairings giving 10 bitangents explicitly
results.modern_name: Steiner complexes / syzygetic representation of a plane quartic, sqrt(ab)+sqrt(cd)+sqrt(ef)=0
results.usually_credited_to: Hesse, Steiner, Aronhold (1855-64); Riemann in posthumous p=3 paper; Weber 1876

results.what: Assignment of odd 2x3 characteristics to bitangents with equal pair-sums for each representation
results.modern_name: Odd theta characteristics <-> 28 bitangents; Steiner complexes as pairs with fixed sum

results.what: sqrt(x x1/(y y1)) = A theta[e_x](u-u1)/theta[e_y](u-u1) * exp
results.modern_name: Quotient of odd theta functions = square root of ratio of bitangent (half-canonical) forms; prime-form identity

results.what: Expression of (theta[001;010]/theta[010;001])^2 through bitangent values at contact points
results.modern_name: Riemann-Weber formulas for genus-3 theta constants via bitangents / Aronhold set (relative of Thomae-type formulas)
results.usually_credited_to: Weber 1876 (Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen vom Geschlecht 3), Riemann Nachlass

deep.surprise_reason: The material matches Riemann's known genus-3 work: the bitangent normal form, characteristics, and theta quotients as roots of bitangent ratios. That work was published from his Nachlass by Weber in 1876 and is credited to him. The attempt to evaluate theta-constant ratios via contact points is a notable working detail but is in line with Weber's published development. The paper reuse (a 1857 legal draft) helps date it.

transcription_corrections: In the characteristic list, the letters given as 'sqrt zeta = [001;001]' and 'sqrt xi = [100;111]' must be interchanged (or the letters are Fraktur variants) to agree with the formulas; consistency requires xi = [001;001], zeta = [100;111].

'sqrt(-y-zeta-eta)' and 'sqrt(-zeta-x-xi)' with characteristics [001;111], [111;001] should be the forms zeta+x+eta and zeta+y+xi (bitangents 9 and X), up to sign. Their characteristic sum [110;110] matches the pairing x xi | y eta.
'5+2+3+[-7-] = 6+1+4' etc. should be read as 7 = 5+2+3 = -(6+1+4) (definitions of bitangents 7, 8, X, 9); '3-7-4+x' and '2-7-1+9' are '= 0' relations, with 'x' denoting bitangent number 10.
The term 'x' in '9x', '-9x', '7+8-x-9' is the numeral ten (X), not the variable x.
Legal text: 'Tagation/Tagatoren' should read 'Taxation/Taxatoren'; 'B. Fassende Melioramente' is probably 'B. Fehlende Melioramente' (parallel to 'A Bestehende Melioramente' on the previous page).
The line '+x eta + y xi(-x-y-eta-xi-zeta) + (y+zeta+eta)(xi+zeta+xi)' should read x eta + y xi - (zeta+y+eta)(zeta+x+xi) (the 'xi+zeta+xi' is zeta+x+xi).
